revenue_leakage.title: Find recoverable revenue
revenue_leakage.prompt: Find all potentially recoverable revenue from the last 30 days. Investigate failed payments, abandoned high-value orders, unpaid invoices, and refund anomalies. Rank opportunities by recoverable value and confidence. Do not execute any action without my approval.

failed_payments.title: Recover failed payments
failed_payments.prompt: Find failed payments with the highest recovery potential. Use customer history, amount, failure reason, and payment attempts to prioritize recovery cases. Do not execute recovery actions without approval.

refund_anomalies.title: Investigate refund anomalies
refund_anomalies.prompt: Find potentially anomalous refunds, especially duplicates. Quantify the value at risk and recommend which cases should be reviewed by finance.
